Hymn 97: Lead, Kindly Light
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: John B. Dykes
Lyricist/Text Author: John H. Newman
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 97 titled "Lead, Kindly Light" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John B. Dykes and the lyrics were written by John H. Newman.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
